title: Microsoft Copilot: build interactive reports and dashboards with Pages
summary: Hold: the automation column presents a configuration resource description as a runnable Microsoft Graph call, without an HTTP method, endpoint or request body. The roadmap facts and admin paths check out, but Microsoft sources disagree about existing Pages storage and Notebooks licensing, and the briefing should disclose those disagreements.

claims.where: controls[0].api; Governance controls: first table row
claims.claim: The printed Tenant Configuration Management resource description supplies a Graph call that configures Pages creation.
claims.quote: Searched: tenantConfigurationManagement applyOnce POST configuration resource Microsoft Graph beta. Read utcm-copilot-resources and configurationmanagement-post-configurationmonitors?view=graph-rest-beta; the printed text is resource metadata, not an HTTP request.
claims.fix: Replace api.call with 'POST https://graph.microsoft.com/beta/admin/configurationManagement/configurationMonitors; Content-Type: application/json; body: <configurationMonitor with displayName, mode="applyOnce", and baseline>' and api.docs with https://learn.microsoft.com/graph/api/configurationmanagement-post-configurationmonitors?view=graph-rest-beta. Move the resource metadata to the row note: 'The baseline resources array uses resourceType microsoft.copilot.copilotpagesnotebooks, resourceVersion 1 and properties.value "0" to disable or "1" to enable; see https://learn.microsoft.com/graph/utcm-copilot-resources. The calling app needs delegated ConfigurationMonitoring.ReadWrite.All, the TCM service principal needs delegated CopilotPolicySettings.ReadWrite, and the signed-in user needs AI Administrator. The target setting must not be configured in any group-level policy.' Preserve the existing preview and tenant-only qualifications. Update the rendered row identically.
